SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS name, u.avatar_file_id AS avatar_file_id, u.phone AS phone, u.status AS status, u.version AS version, u.created_at AS registered_at, u.last_login_at AS last_login_at, u.last_login_client AS last_login_client, u.recovery_lock_until AS recovery_lock_until, u.recovered_at AS recovered_at, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(f.name ORDER BY f.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS farm_names_text, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS farm_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role = 'OWNER') AS owner_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role = 'MANAGER') AS manager_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role = 'STAFF') AS staff_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm f WHERE f.owner_user_id = u.id AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.audit_status = 'PENDING') AS farm_pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_account_recovery r WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.status = 'PENDING') AS recovery_pending FROM t_user u WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u WHERE 1 = 1 AND u.status = #{status} AND u.status <> 'CANCELLED'
AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR (#{keyword} REGEXP '^[0-9]{11}$' AND u.phone = #{keyword}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role = 'OWNER')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role = 'MANAGER')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role = 'STAFF')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE')
AND u.created_at >= #{registeredFrom} AND u.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{registeredTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id AS farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.role AS role, f.audit_status AS audit_status, f.disabled AS disabled, f.frozen AS frozen, c.count_unit AS count_unit, c.name AS category_name, f.scale AS scale, m.joined_at AS joined_at, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.current_count), 0) FROM t_batch b WHERE b.farm_id = f.id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.deleted = 0) AS stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_member_pen mp WHERE mp.member_id = m.id AND mp.farm_id = f.id) AS pen_count FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = f.main_category_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY m.joined_at ASC, f.id ASC
SELECT created_at FROM t_recovery_code WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status FROM t_account_recovery WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
